ns2:section.sectionText: Senior priority enrollment begins November 6th. Junior priority enrollment begins November 13th. All Restrictions lifted at 9:00 am on November 18th. Presents an overview and analysis of historical and current theory and research on moral psychology. Explores development of morality, moral reasoning and decision-making, rational and biased inputs to moral judgments, moral emotions, moral impression formation and person perception. Emphasis is on the social psychology of morality, but other perspectives such as developmental, cognitive, political, and individual differences will be explored. Prerequisite: PSYC 100 or equivalent. **Elective Course for Intradisciplinary or Personality or Social Psychology Concentration**
